dedupe_keys.name: uk port congestion data 17 uk and ireland ports weekly

description: This dataset gives weekly congestion health scores from 0 to 100 for 17 ports in the United Kingdom and Ireland, including Felixstowe, Southampton, London Gateway, Liverpool, Grangemouth, Holyhead, Dublin and Belfast. For each port it provides the health score, its 7-day and 30-day change, the number of vessels waiting and at berth, berth utilisation, waiting time and a trend. The score is a composite in which higher is better, and the publisher notes that the 7-day and 30-day movement matters more than the absolute value. It is published by Carrgo Freight Solutions every Wednesday and versioned by date on Zenodo. Coverage is 17 ports. Access: free CSV and JSON files with a README under CC BY 4.0; the version read was published 2026-08-27. Caveats: the composite method and the underlying vessel data sources are only briefly described, and the series is short. It supports port service performance monitoring, disruption detection and calibration of port and supply chain models, and complements the UK DfT maritime shipping statistics catalogued here.
